newsitem.title: USA: South San Francisco confirms Firstpoint power deal.
newsitem.headline: South San Francisco confirms Firstpoint power deal.

text.p: City of South San Francisco confirmed Thursday the selection of FirstPoint California Inc to provide energy services to the city for five years starting next year.
California will begin in January to allow retail electricity consumers to choose their own supplier.
FirstPoint, a subsidiary of Oregon-based Portland General Corp, is also the energy services provider to the city of Palm Springs.
Under the South San Francisco agreement, FirstPoint will provide energy and energy-related services for business and residential customers.
They will also support customer and economic development services to attract new industry to the San Francisco Bay area city, which has a population of 57,000.
